dedupe_keys.name: hydroshare hydrologic data and model platform

description: HydroShare is CUAHSI and contributors' web application for sharing hydrologic data and models and connecting them to analysis applications. It supports resource discovery, access permissions, publication and web-service access, with applications that visualise, analyse or run models on shared data. Inputs are hydrologic files, metadata and access settings; outputs are reusable resource pages, API responses and connected analysis workflows. Geographic coverage, observation periods and resolutions vary by deposited resource. Source is free under BSD-3-Clause; deposited resources carry their own licences and permissions. The repository documents a Python/Django server stack and local development setup. A limitation is that running the full service requires several coordinated services and does not make restricted deposits public. HydroShare supports infrastructure water-model preparation and reuse. The Clean Watersheds Needs Survey record (data-epa-clean-watersheds-needs-survey-2022) is a hosted dataset, not this platform. No server was installed or account accessed.
name: HydroShare hydrologic data and model platform
notes: G7 G7-0936. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability. Existing HydroShare-hosted datasets and their accepted candidates do not cover the separately reusable server software.
